mapper.select: SELECT user_id, nickname, status, blacklist_reason, updated_at FROM user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_profile (user_id, nickname, status, blacklist_reason, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{nickname}, #{status}, #{blacklistReason}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE nickname = VALUES(nickname), status = VALUES(status), blacklist_reason = VALUES(blacklist_reason), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
